what: does a prjxray mask account for the post-fault readback disagreement
scope_caveat: masks exist upstream only for CLB tiles; INT, BRAM and IOB frames have none, so a mask cannot speak for most of the device
reading: Masking removes bits but produces no non-zero positive control: not one frame whose base content is non-zero becomes equal to its readback once the dynamic bits prjxray names are excluded. The disagreement is not the dynamic bits.
